title: Get a reviewable training strategy
description: ML Advisor uses only the dataset profile and available components to propose an editable experiment. You decide whether to train it.

objective.label: What do you want to predict?
objective.placeholder: Example: Predict which patients are likely to miss an appointment.
objective.examplesHelp: An example only fills the field. Nothing runs until you choose an action.

auto.help: This option validates the strategy, creates the experiment, and starts training immediately.

privacy.profileOnly: Privacy: no dataset rows were sent; only schema and aggregate profile were used.
privacy.sampleSent: Privacy: {{count}} sample rows were sent because LLM_SEND_SAMPLE is enabled.

review.label: Review and edit the proposal
review.help: The proposal is validated again when you create the experiment draft.
review.invalidJson: The edited proposal is not valid JSON.
review.noTraining: Creating the draft does not start training.

errors.llm_configuration_error: Configure the selected LLM provider and model before requesting advice.
errors.llm_response_error: The provider returned an invalid recommendation. Try again or select another model.
errors.llm_transport_error: The configured LLM provider could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
errors.llm_provider_error: The configured LLM provider could not complete the recommendation. Try again or select another model.
errors.invalid_advisor_recommendation: The AI could not produce a valid configuration, even after another attempt. No training was started. Generate a new recommendation or configure the experiment manually.
errors.invalidProposal: The edited proposal could not be validated. Review its fields and try again.
errors.unknown: The recommendation could not be generated. Try again or use manual configuration.
